name: auth-magic-link
title: Auth — Magic link
description: Passwordless magic-link sign-in for Lunora auth. Wires better-auth's magicLink plugin on top of the base `auth` item and delivers the sign-in link through @lunora/mail (captured into the studio Mail tab in dev).
docs: Add `magicLinkPlugin` to your auth instance's `plugins` array in lunora/auth/index.ts: `import { magicLinkPlugin } from "./magic-link.js"` then `plugins: [magicLinkPlugin(env)]`. The link is emailed via @lunora/mail using MAIL_FROM (already set by the base auth item); in dev it lands in the studio Mail tab, for production delivery run `lunora add email` (SEND_EMAIL binding) or set RESEND_API_KEY. Trigger it client-side with `authClient.signIn.magicLink({ email })`.
